passage:
El Niño is a weather pattern that often brings months of below-normal rainfall to the Philippines. When it strikes, dams hold less water, and some households face water interruptions. Saving water at home can help everyone get through the dry months.

A family can catch rainwater in clean drums whenever it does rain and use it for flushing toilets or watering plants. Washing dishes in a basin, instead of under a running faucet, can save many liters a day. Leaks should be fixed quickly, because a dripping faucet can waste thousands of liters in a year. Even small habits, such as turning off the tap while brushing your teeth, add up when millions of people practice them.
